nodes.name: Route handlers
nodes.responsibility: Answers every request: board reads, the one write boundary with its claim, rename and discard, the code checks, the repositories and checkout choice, the page, health and opening vault
nodes.description: Board routes, Board write routes, Claim routes, Rename route, Discard route, Service routes, Code check route, Locality route and Footprint route. Their own board draws each one with the parts it reaches.

nodes.name: Codex workbench
nodes.responsibility: Adapts Archboard's context, tools, narration and checkout admission to the voice agent it hosts through createVoiceAgent

nodes.name: HTTP listener
nodes.responsibility: The one Express application and the HTTP server that answers for it

nodes.name: Live panes
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the panes on screen, their sockets and tabs, and board announcements live
nodes.description: Pane routes, Pane socket, Pane registry, Board announcements, Change feed, Tab session presence and Disk change watcher form this server subsystem. Board content stays on disk; the subsystem holds only screen and session state.

nodes.name: HTTP serving
nodes.responsibility: Takes every HTTP call: mounts the routes on one application and listener, refuses foreign browser origins and calls that name no vault, and opens a node's code.

nodes.name: Panes and the workbench
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the panes on screen with their sockets, tabs and board news, and owns the private Codex child that is bridged to those panes.

nodes.name: Codex realtime voice
nodes.responsibility: Owns the reusable Codex generations, sessions, workhorses, approvals and voice behind createVoiceAgent, with the host's identity and policy

edges.description: a pane's tab, and the end of a tab gone for 60 s; the board the pane shows
